map.由买卖价与股息求持有期收益率: Compute holding-period return from buy/sell prices and dividends
map.输入买入价、卖出价与期间股息，求持有期收益率。: Enter the buy price, sell price and dividends received to compute the holding-period return.
map.📖 查看「由买卖价与股息求持有期收益率 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Compute holding-period return from buy/sell prices and dividends User Guide"
map.计算买入到卖出的总回报（含资本利得与股息）。: Computes total return from buy to sell (including capital gain and dividends).
map.多笔买卖合并算期回报。: Combine multiple buys and sells into one holding-period return.
map.与年化回报换算（已知持有天数）。: Convert to annualized return (given holding days).
map.本工具红利按现金计入；若分红再投资，需用复权价计算总回报，结果通常略高。: This tool counts dividends as cash; if dividends are reinvested, use the adjusted (ex-rights) price to compute total return, which is usually slightly higher.
map.年化 = (1+期回报)^(365/持有天数) − 1。持有 半年、回报 14%: Annualized = (1+period return)^(365/holding days) - 1. Holding half a year with 14% return -> annualized ≈ (1.14)^2 - 1 ≈ 29.96%.
